title: cattleya × heitoriana
intro: Cattleya × heitoriana, commonly known as the Heitoriana orchid, is a hybrid species of orchid that belongs to the Cattleya genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure and act as an anti-inflammatory agent due to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are believed to include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the Heitoriana orchid has been studied for its potential to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress through its calming effects.
